title: Episode 7
method: The victim was slipped sedatives and put on the killer's boat before a severe storm. His co-conspirator wore the victim's clothes and boarded a fishing boat with an urn, with the intention of being seen by witnesses. She then sailed out to where the victim was and switched clothes with her. She also moved the victim to the fishing boat and sailed back on the first boat.
motive: The killers knew that the victim's ring was worth a lot of money, however, the victim was very attached to her ring so the only way to steal it was to kill her.
killer: The proprietor of the restaurant nearby and a neighbour
tags: killer pretending to be victim to establish alibi
